basic_info.description: Brand new, 2 Bedroom 2 Bath home, with Crane Cove Park Views over looking the court yard. Features include Miele appliances and gorgeous marble countertops. Balcony included. Designed by Woods Bagot, 2177 Third is luxury living that is quintessentially San Francisco and features curated amenities like a landscaped center courtyard, private gym, rooftop terrace, pet spa, residence lounge and co-working space. All photography, renderings & views are representative of the Development.
